consignas.consigna: Escribe un email a un amigo contándole tu rutina diaria: a qué hora te levantas, qué haces y cómo es tu casa.
consignas.respuestaModelo: Hi! I get up at six o'clock every day. I have breakfast and I go to work. I live in a small apartment with a bedroom, a kitchen and a bathroom. In the evening I clean my house. See you!
checklist: Usé un saludo y una despedida
Dije a qué hora te levantas
Describí tu rutina con presente simple

consignas.consigna: Escribe sobre tu ropa: qué llevas normalmente, de qué colores, y describe un objeto que siempre llevas contigo.
consignas.respuestaModelo: Usually I wear jeans and a blue t-shirt. In winter I wear a black coat and brown shoes. I always have my phone and my keys in my bag. My phone is white and it is new.
checklist: Describí un objeto que siempre llevas

consignas.consigna: Escribe a un amigo sobre las fechas importantes: qué día es hoy, cuándo es tu cumpleaños y en qué estación cae.
consignas.respuestaModelo: Hi Paul! Today is Monday. It is the third of May. My birthday is on the tenth of July, in summer. My mother's birthday is in December, in winter. See you tomorrow!

consignas.consigna: Escribe sobre tus horarios: a qué hora trabajas o estudias y con qué frecuencia haces cada cosa.
consignas.respuestaModelo: Hello! It is nine o'clock now. I am always in my office at eight o'clock. I work from eight to five. Sometimes I am tired. On Sunday I am with my family. See you soon!
checklist: Coloqué el adverbio en su sitio

consignas.consigna: Escribe tu rutina diaria en presente simple: qué haces cada día y en qué orden.
consignas.respuestaModelo: I wake up at six every day. I have breakfast and I take a shower. Then I go to my office and I work. In the afternoon I study. I have dinner at eight and I sleep at eleven.

consignas.consigna: Describe lo que hay en tu mochila: qué objetos son, de qué color y de quién son.
consignas.respuestaModelo: This is my bag. In my bag there is a book and a computer. The book is red and it is mine. There is a phone. That phone is my sister's. These keys are mine too.

consignas.consigna: Escribe tu semana: qué haces cada día, en qué mes es tu cumpleaños y cuál es tu estación favorita.
consignas.respuestaModelo: On Monday and on Tuesday I work in the office. On Wednesday I study. On Thursday and on Friday I am with my friends. On the weekend I am with my family. My birthday is in June, in winter. Summer is very good for me: December and January.
checklist: Hablé de al menos cuatro días
Dije el mes de mi cumpleaños

consignas.consigna: Escribe a qué hora haces tres cosas del día y con qué frecuencia: usa siempre, a veces, casi nunca.
consignas.respuestaModelo: It is half past seven in the morning and I am always early. My work is from eight o'clock to two o'clock. At noon I have half an hour. In the afternoon I usually study at a quarter past four. I am sometimes late, but I am never late for work.

consignas.consigna: Escribe la rutina de otra persona (un amigo o alguien de tu familia), de la mañana a la noche.
consignas.respuestaModelo: My brother wakes up at seven and he gets up quickly. He has a shower and he gets dressed. He has breakfast and he goes to work at eight. He comes back at three and he has lunch. In the evening he cooks and he listens to music. He goes to bed at eleven.
checklist: Conté la mañana, la tarde y la noche
Usé al menos seis verbos de rutina

consignas.consigna: Describe una habitación de tu casa: qué hay y dónde está cada cosa (usa near, next to, under, between, on).
consignas.respuestaModelo: This is my bedroom. There is a bed under the window and there is a wardrobe next to the door. There is a lamp near the bed and a mirror on the wall. Between the bed and the wardrobe there is a chair. There is no sofa, but the room is very nice.
checklist: Usé al menos cuatro preposiciones de lugar

consignas.consigna: Escribe qué llevas en tu mochila y de qué color es cada cosa, y di dónde está algo que NO llevas.
consignas.respuestaModelo: In my bag there is a black computer and a blue notebook. There are two pens: a red pen and a green pen. My phone is white and it is always here. I have my keys, my wallet and my money. My watch is not in the bag: it is on the table.
checklist: Dije el color de al menos cuatro
Dije dónde está lo que no llevo

consignas.consigna: Escribe qué ropa te pones en invierno y qué ropa en verano, y di qué es caro y qué es barato.
consignas.respuestaModelo: In winter I put on a big coat, boots and gloves. I wear a sweater and trousers. The coat is very expensive, but the sweater is cheap. In summer I wear a t-shirt, shorts and sneakers. I never wear a jacket in summer. In bed I wear my pyjamas.
checklist: Hablé del invierno y del verano

consignas.consigna: Examen: escribe el calendario de tu semana y de tu año: qué haces cada día, en qué mes es tu cumpleaños y qué pasa en cada estación.
consignas.respuestaModelo: I work from Monday to Thursday. On Friday I am with my family and on the weekend I am with my friends. My birthday is in November, in autumn. In summer, in June and July, I am in Peru. In winter it is December and January here. Today is Friday and tomorrow is Saturday.
checklist: Hablé de los días de la semana
Dije el mes de mi cumpleaños
Usé 'on' con los días y 'in' con los meses

consignas.consigna: Examen: escribe tu horario completo de un día con cinco horas distintas y di con qué frecuencia haces cada cosa.
consignas.respuestaModelo: It is half past six in the morning and I am always early. My work is from eight o'clock to two o'clock. At noon I have half an hour. In the afternoon I usually study at a quarter past four. In the evening, at nine, I am with my friends. At eleven I am in bed. I am never late.

consignas.consigna: Examen: escribe tu rutina entera de un día, de que te levantas a que te acuestas, en orden.
consignas.respuestaModelo: I wake up at seven and I get up quickly. I have a shower, I brush my teeth and I get dressed. I make the bed and I have breakfast. I go to work at eight and I finish at two. I have lunch and I rest. In the evening I cook. I go to bed at eleven.
checklist: Conté la mañana, la tarde y la noche
Usé al menos ocho verbos de rutina

consignas.consigna: Examen: describe tu casa entera, habitación por habitación, diciendo qué hay y dónde está cada cosa.
consignas.respuestaModelo: In my apartment there are three rooms. In the living room there is a sofa, a table and two chairs, and a lamp near the sofa. In the kitchen there is a fridge next to the window. In my bedroom my bed is under the window and the wardrobe is between the bed and the door. There is no garden.
checklist: Usé cuatro preposiciones de lugar distintas

consignas.consigna: Examen: escribe todo lo que llevas en tu mochila con su color, y di dónde está algo que no llevas.
consignas.respuestaModelo: In my bag there is a black computer and a green notebook. There are two pens: a red pen and a purple pen. There is a yellow pencil and some paper. My phone is white and my keys are here, with my wallet and my money. My watch is not in the bag: it is on the table.
checklist: Dije el color de al menos cinco
Dije dónde está lo que no llevo

consignas.consigna: Examen: escribe qué ropa te pones en cada estación, qué es caro y qué es barato, y qué talla usas.
consignas.respuestaModelo: In winter I put on a big coat, boots and gloves, and I wear a sweater. My coat is grey and it is cheap. In summer I wear a t-shirt, shorts and sneakers. In spring I wear jeans and a jacket. I am a forty. Elegant clothes are expensive. In bed I wear my pyjamas.
checklist: Hablé de al menos tres estaciones
